Hi Aisha,

Thanks — we have received the W-9 and COI. Quick next steps from our side to get you into the vendor master and enable PO issuance:

1) Please complete the attached Redwood Vendor Master Form (link below) and return the filled spreadsheet so Finance has structured fields for legal name, remit address, tax ID, and payment method.
2) If you plan to receive ACH, please include the bank letter and a voided check (PDF).
3) Confirm whether the legal entity on the W-9 (Onyx Logistics, Inc.) is the entity that will sign contracts and receive payments. If not, provide the exact legal entity name that matches tax documents.
4) Please advise if Onyx can accept Redwood's standard PO terms (Net30, electronic PO, standard SOC2 data handling addendum). If there are any exceptions (e.g., older master services agreement, different payment terms), flag them now.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExampleDriveLinkRedwoodVendorForm (Redwood Vendor Master Form)

Priyom / Aisha — looping in Finance & Legal checks so we have a clear audit trail. A few items we need before we create the vendor master record: 

- Confirmed legal entity name that exactly matches the W-9 and state of incorporation. If Onyx is operating under multiple entities, specify which entity Redwood will contract with.
- Remit-to address for ACH/Check and the preferred invoice email.
- Bank letter or voided check for ACH. If using third-party payment processors, please detail them.
- Confirm that the COI lists Redwood Inference as the certificate holder (if not, please request an updated COI).
- Any special tax forms for non-US entities (not applicable if Onyx is US-based).

We typically set up vendors with Net30 and issue standard POs. If Onyx needs a vendor form with vendor type (Goods/Services/Contractor), please indicate — we'll mark you as Freight Carrier / Third-Party Logistics.

Marcus, please advise on any contract signature requirements or if the vendor needs to accept Redwood's standard terms before PO issuance.
